narrative.text: Tomas Bernabo contributed to multiple TrueSight DAO projects including 20250617_beerhall, Agroverse, Edgar, and TrueSight DAO itself over the period from March 2023 to April 2025. His contributions primarily centered on Build Game - Strategy, with frequent attendance at FaceTime meetings every 30 minutes (9 instances) and logged hours of human effort (7 instances), alongside providing reference materials with strategy extensions (2) and bringing on active contributors (2). He also supported commerce efforts by sourcing SKUs with details (2), injecting liquidity (2), and handled events planning through venue sourcing and setup (1) plus rectifying a copywriting error (1).
